title: Q-RAG: Long Context Multi‑Step Retrieval via Value‑Based Embedder Training

layout.note: Three stacked bands: the Q-RAG Agent box on top, the row of document chunks in the middle, the Environment box at the bottom; arrows run up from the chunks to the action embedder, and loop arrows around the left and right sides close the cycle.

lesson: Draw an RL method over text as one closed loop: agent box above, environment box below, the document as a row of sticky-note chunks between them, state and action as small equations of coloured chips, and side arrows that close the cycle.
